question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Blistering**
solution:
The correct answer is: **2) Chilly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Blistering"** refers to something intensely hot or extremely fast. It is often used to describe heat, speed, or intensity. (जलता हुआ, अत्यंत गर्म)

 
 
• **Example:** The blistering heat of the desert is unbearable during summer.
 

 
• **"Chilly"** means uncomfortably cold or cool, and it is the antonym of "Blistering." (ठंडा, ठंड से भरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The morning was chilly, and everyone wore jackets to stay warm.
